newsitem.title: UK: Roehlig names Air Marketing Associates as UK agent.
newsitem.headline: Roehlig names Air Marketing Associates as UK agent.

text.p: UK-based cargo general sales agent Air Marketing Associates (AMA) said it has been appointed to market ex-UK trucking services for German transport operator Roehlig and Company.
AMA said that it will sell Roehlig's weekly express groupage services from the UK to Russia, Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic and Slovakia.

As well an intra-European surface freight system, Roehlig offers airfreight and deep-sea services worldwide through a network of 70 owned offices in the Far East, Australasia, the U.S. and South Africa. It also has partner agents in other major markets.

AMA has in the past concentrated on acting as a cargo GSA for airlines, many of them based in eastern Europe and the former Soviet Union, and its managing director Len Bunn said the new departure would complement this original role.

"Our agent customers work increasingly in a logistics-driven environment, in which airfreight is not always the automatic transport mode. This places pressure on them to offer viable alternatives or risk losing business opportunities -- or even existing customers," he said.
